reasons: Aggregation differs: the Datadog query is sum:nginx.net.connections with no rollup, but the candidate wraps the selector in avg(), which yields a different value.
The candidate adds state="active" filter that the Datadog request does not have; the source sums all connections, so the candidate selects a different set of series.

The Datadog template variable $Host (prefix host, default *) is dropped; it should become a host matcher such as host_name=~"$Host" (label name must be checked against the dataset), so the candidate is not scoped the same way.
Outcome translated is correct since no Datadog function is present in the query or formula; the widget title 'per second' does not add a function.
Unit {connections} is consistent between Datadog and the OTel definition.
